name: Sleek
summary: AI mobile app design tool that turns text prompts or sketches into multi-screen iOS and Android app designs.
description: A web app that generates mobile app UI designs from text descriptions or hand-drawn sketches, organised into multi-screen projects with consistent design systems. Designs export to Figma as editable layers, to HTML and React with Tailwind, and to AI builders; coding agents can drive it through a REST API, MCP server or agent skill. App design templates and a references gallery give starting points.
contains: free tier: 60 one-time credits, 1 project, 3 screens
plans: Starter, Pro $69/mo, Team $99/seat/mo; yearly billing saves up to 59%
mobile app design templates across 11 categories (finance, health, travel, education …)
exports: Figma layers, HTML/React with Tailwind, AI builders
REST API, remote MCP server and official agent skill for AI coding agents
references gallery of hand-picked app designs
